content:
leo: Hey team, spotted a customer report: after a client reconnect, they were billed twice for the same toolcall tokens when streaming resumed. Looks like provisional + confirmed both applied. Any idea?
anya: ugh. Is this the stream-resume codepath where we re-emit the final toolcall chunk?
tom: likely. We mark provisional credits on start-of-stream and confirm on finalization. If the client reconnects and replays the suffix, we might create a new provisional charge for the replayed tokens and then confirm both.
kat: can you dump a minimal trace id?
leo: trace=tr_2026_03_21_99. timeline: client open -> toolcall invoked -> provisional_charge P1 created -> network hiccup -> reconnect -> replay chunk -> provisional_charge P2 -> session finalize -> both P1 & P2 confirmed.
anya: does the reconnect reuse the same session id? If not, accounting keying will treat them separate and double-charge.
tom: router does sticky session mapping but we also copy headers: `x-client-session` and `x-attribution`. If the replay creates a new session id but still carries the original `x-attribution`, accounting dedupe logic fails because it keys by session id + sequence.
kat: quick mitigation: accounting should prefer an idempotency token from the toolcall payload (toolcall_id) if present. We already accept `toolcall_id` for sync calls; for streaming we dropped it.
leo: adding: client libraries often don't send toolcall_id on reconnect. We need server-side dedupe that understands replay windows.
ops-sql: we can query for confirmed charges where customer=cust-5678 and toolcall_signature matches and time delta < 5m — sounds like we can backfill refunds.
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-900 created for reconciliation (cust-5678).
anya: fix plan: 1) update router to propagate `toolcall_id` from initial start into reconnects (server-side canonicalization) 2) make accounting dedupe by `toolcall_id` OR (session_id + seq_range) 3) add a short grace dedupe window (10s) for confirm step to ignore duplicate confirms.
tom: code sketch: ```
// accounting pseudo
key = toolcall_id ?? session_id + start_seq
if (already_confirmed(key)) return;
confirm_and_finalize(key);
```
kat: also, sanitize forwarded `x-attribution` on reconnects. If the reconnect is a server-side resume, router should set `internal_owner=system` unless client auth explicitly owns it.
leo: good. console request: add a chart "reconnect double-confirm events" and a log link that filters by trace id and customer. ops needs quick triage panel.
ops-sql: I'll add the panel and run a query for the last 72h to find similar traces.
anya: tests: unit for accounting dedupe, integration to simulate reconnect and ensure only one confirmed charge. Add a stress test for interleaved toolcalls + reconnects.
tom: short-term mitigation: roll back the change that started preserving `x-attribution` on forwarded reconnects (PR #4042) and feature-gate the new behavior until dedupe is in place.
leo: can we also treat provisional charges as reversible until a unique finalize token is observed? That would let us auto-revoke duplicates before confirming.
kat: yes but be careful: we can't leave provisional gaps for too long. Proposed: provisional expires after 30s unless finalized; duplicates auto-revoke if same toolcall_signature observed.
billing-bot: Noted: provisional auto-revocation policy will require billing approval. Opening BILL-901 for policy change.
ops-sql: Found 6 traces matching the pattern in last 48h; opening follow-up tickets per customer.
leo: assign owners: tom -> accounting dedupe, anya -> router header sanitization + canonicalization, kat -> console panel, ops-sql -> reconciliation queries + refunds.
kat: ETA: router change + tests tomorrow AM, accounting PR in 48h, console panel in 2h for triage.
leo: thanks. please ping BILL-900/BILL-901 when reconciliations are created. :thumbsup:
